title: Power Surge T3 spirit-resist shred before the ult
question: Does one Power Surge burst on the target before the ult raise storm damage on surge-hit targets by ~15% (T3 -15% spirit resist, 10 s)?
hypothesis: H-L8: storm damage on the surged bot(s) +12-15% over the debuff window vs no pre-surge; free (no souls), playstyle only.

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: give items; enemies 3 300 8; arm casts; wait 21

metrics.name: storm_dmg_surged_bot
metrics.how: damage csv, main bot, first 10 s

decision.rule: >=10% supports a playstyle line (no note: notes never explain procs)
